rss_method: Linux /usr/bin/time %M: fresh isolated installed CLI, peak resident KiB; %e elapsed seconds

arithmetic.reference: Linear LoRA: delta = (B_float64 @ A_float64) * scale; DoRA: direction = base_float64 + (B_float64 @ A_float64) * scale; reference_weight = row_normalize(direction) * magnitude_float64; delta = reference_weight - base_float64; no dense full-layer delta retained
arithmetic.residual: observed - delta; reported relative to the Frobenius norm of delta
arithmetic.zero_change: exact numeric equality to the base rounded to the merged dtype
arithmetic.reference_merge: LoRA: round_to_merged_dtype(base_float64 + delta); DoRA: round_to_merged_dtype(reference_weight); ties to even
arithmetic.projection_gain: dot(observed, delta) / dot(delta, delta); null for a zero reference
arithmetic.cosine_similarity: dot(observed, delta) / (norm(observed) * norm(delta)); null if either is zero
arithmetic.unchanged_reference_energy: squared delta norm at unchanged positions / squared delta norm; null if delta is zero
arithmetic.unadapted: must equal base rounded to merged dtype; integers require identical dtype/values
arithmetic.scope: saved Linear LoRA/DoRA, standard GPT Conv1D LoRA, Embedding LoRA and explicit full modules; no architecture execution or quality estimate
arithmetic.conv1d_reference: delta = (B_float64 @ A_float64).T * scale; saved weight rows are inputs, columns are outputs; standard GPT module paths resolved from declared model metadata, not a global orientation flag
arithmetic.embedding_reference: delta = (B_float64 @ A_float64).T * scale; weight rows are token indices, columns are embedding dimensions; A columns are streamed, B is retained in full

limitations: Supplied base identity and training provenance are not independently established.
Equal weights do not distinguish rounding from an omitted or wrong adapter.
The float64 reference is numerical; it is not a PEFT merge emulator.
DoRA normalizes rows of the supplied original base plus its directional update.
Tensor shapes and a global adapter flag do not establish every module's type.
Operation order and matmul precision can differ from the producer, notably at ties.
Weight-space changes and residuals do not establish generation or task quality.
Missing tensors, unsupported variants and nonfinite inputs refuse the whole audit.
